Dear Customer,

We sincerely apologize for the billing error on your account last month. We’ve identified that you were charged at an incorrect plan tier and have processed a refund of **120** to your account. Your account is now correctly billed at the **BRONZE** tier.

Please review your billing statement for confirmation. If you have any questions or notice further discrepancies, reply to this email or contact our support team.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
[Your Company Name] Support Team
